title: POST /users accepts body fields the API reference forbids
goal: Make POST /users enforce the documented rules for every request body field, as described in docs/api.md.

approvedRules.title: Keep the public response format
approvedRules.content: Every endpoint answers { data } or { error: { code, message } }. Never add, rename, or remove top-level response fields, and never return an empty body.

approvedRules.title: Use the shared validators
approvedRules.content: Validate request input with the helpers in src/lib/validate.ts and reply 400 VALIDATION_FAILED on bad input.

acceptance: A request whose age is negative, fractional, non-numeric, missing, or above the documented maximum is rejected with 400 and the { error: { code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', message } } shape
A valid request still returns 201 with exactly the same data fields as before
No change to the public response fields or to other endpoints
